examples.solution_text:
(a) Multiply every term in the first bracket by every term in the second. A negative times a negative is positive.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(x-7)(x-2)\\&=x^2-2x-7x+14\\&=x^2-9x+14\end{aligned}$
(b) Keep the sign of $-5$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(2y-5)(3y+4)\\&=6y^2+8y-15y-20\\&=6y^2-7y-20\end{aligned}$

(a) A square means multiplying the bracket by itself.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(4z-3)^2\\&=(4z-3)(4z-3)\\&=16z^2-12z-12z+9\\&=16z^2-24z+9\end{aligned}$
(b) Keep the negative sign attached to $-z$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(3z-5)(2-z)\\&=6z-3z^2-10+5z\\&=-3z^2+11z-10\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(3a-b)(2a+5)\\&=3a(2a+5)-b(2a+5)\\&=6a^2+15a-2ab-5b\end{aligned}$
There are no like terms to collect.

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(2x+a)(3x+b)\\&=2x(3x+b)+a(3x+b)\\&=6x^2+2bx+3ax+ab\end{aligned}$
The terms $2bx$ and $3ax$ have different pronumeral parts, so leave them separate.

examples.derivation: The four rectangles have areas uv, 5u, 2v and 10, giving uv+5u+2v+10. The solution labels match their side lengths and positions; the question diagram contains only givens. This follows the supplied area-model teaching.

(a) The products are x², −2x, −7x and 14, giving x²−9x+14. (b) The products are 6y², 8y, −15y and −20, giving 6y²−7y−20. Both follow the supplied distributive rule and preserve the baseline mathematics.

(a) Repeated factors give 16z²−12z−12z+9=16z²−24z+9. (b) The products are 6z, −3z², −10 and 5z, giving −3z²+11z−10. Squared brackets and reversed linear factors are supported by the supplied exercises; no special-product shortcut is introduced.

Distributing gives 6a²+15a−2ab−5b. The four terms have different pronumeral parts and cannot be collected. This adapts the supplied unlike-pronumeral guided practice and preserves the baseline mathematics.

The four products are 6x², 2bx, 3ax and ab. For independent symbolic coefficients a and b, the middle products have different pronumeral parts. This is a supported specialization of the supplied symbolic-coefficient exercise and preserves the baseline mathematics.
